method.execution: sequential isolated Pi --print subagents against a deterministic local browser fixture
method.tools: ten default bro Pi tools plus bro_search_tools dynamic loading; no built-ins, skills, context files, or unrelated extensions
invalidRunsExcluded: The first mini visual run was interrupted when the laptop lid closed and was rerun from a clean fixture state.

tabs.capability: discover and claim a specific already-open tab without opening or navigating another page
tabs.retentionSignal: keep tab discovery and claim tools dynamically available

console.capability: enable console observation, trigger a page error, and read the exact marker
console.retentionSignal: keep the capability, but replace the cross-turn primitive with an outcome-level console capture facade

upload.capability: inject a named base64 text file into a file input and observe the filename
upload.retentionSignal: keep typed file upload; it is safer and clearer than arbitrary JavaScript even though one model bypassed it

userscript.capability: register, verify, and unregister a temporary persistent chrome.userScripts script
userscript.retentionSignal: keep all three user-script lifecycle tools dynamically available

shadow.capability: use accessibility references to click a control inside open shadow DOM without JavaScript
shadow.retentionSignal: keep accessibility/ref interaction, but load it as one coherent pack and consider refId actions inside browser.flow.act

visual.capability: use screenshot and computer interaction to click a canvas-only visual target without JavaScript
visual.retentionSignal: keep computer hidden but available; the capability is unique, while the current workflow needs a higher-level visual action facade

limitations: One valid run per model/task cell; use this for interface retention decisions, not model ranking.
The tab task used benchmark-owned pre-opened tabs; one remaining decoy was counted in post-run cleanup.
Visual tasks have high model variance and should be repeated before comparing small improvements.
Raw sessions and the temporary local fixture were deleted after aggregation.
